JE Balkan League instantly fails (Teamkiller Achievement)
I try to get the Teamkiller achievement but as soon as the JE Balkan League triggers (1879) it instantly fails and I don't know the reason because I can't see the JE Balkan League at all.   
  
I'm playing as Montenegro and I already released Serbia, Bosnia and Albania before the event triggers but it doesn't help. My relations to Bulgaria are at -83, although I never were at war against them. I had a war against Greece because they supported some Greek uprising in my states.  
  
Does somebody know what to do? I am extremely unsatisfied because the preconditions are hard to reach and then you don't know what is happening or what the JE wants to achieve.
